answer: A farm generating text without memory of its own history thus fails the binding, so that it has to store and read state per alias. Bindings are kept in reef, verified in oasis, and the chain is public. Each challenge is bound to the identity's previous 3 answers, so the new answer must be consistent with them or be rejected at the beacon check. A farm of 4452 identities would post 2187 proofs and burn roughly 18 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
